query: Before we build it, define done for issue #42 in this repo: "export reports as CSV so users can open them in Excel".
expected_behavior: Runs dod.mjs open before anything else and saves the issue word for word with gh issue view 42 --comments redirected to the literal run path
Sends a low-tier read-only subagent for facts (report pages, existing exports, specs) and does not ask the user anything it can look up
Asks one numbered round with every question it can ask now, each stating what it saw and where, with a recommended answer and options lettered A, B, C
Covers the five required sections: feature flag and default, backward compatibility, non-goals, verify environment and test tiers
Saves each answer word for word to answers.md as A<n> blocks with a time line, and keeps each question in its DoD item
Does not propose an architecture or UI variants
Runs dod.mjs check until it passes, shows docs/dod/<slug>.md, and waits for the user to confirm

query: Enough questions, just write the DoD with what you have. I'll answer the rest later.
expected_behavior: Moves every open question to the unconfirmed list instead of guessing an answer
Does not mark any item as assumed without the user's written acceptance naming that item
Reports that dod.mjs check fails and export is refused until each open question is answered or accepted, listing the questions
Does not write product code or run export

query: The DoD is confirmed. Update the Jira ticket ABC-12 with it.
expected_behavior: Runs dod.mjs tools --system jira and uses acli when it is on PATH, otherwise asks the user before using the third-party jira CLI, otherwise MCP, otherwise render --fallback
Runs render, rewrites the whole description keeping every original sentence, and runs ticket-check until it passes
Shows the full new description and asks the user to run dod.mjs approve themselves; never runs approve or trust itself
Updates ABC-12 only and never creates a ticket or a subtask
Reads the ticket back after posting and runs ticket-check --posted, reporting any difference without pulling it back into the repo

query: The DoD for report-export is confirmed and the ticket is posted. Record it so paired-agent-tdd and qa-sweep can read it, and so we can see later why we chose what we chose.
expected_behavior: Has kept every grill question in <run>/questions.md when it was asked, each option with at least one pro and one con and a recommendation
Keeps the DoD JSON in <run>/dod.json, not in docs/dod, and runs dod.mjs adr --dod with that path
Reorganizes only the Context, Decision and Consequences prose and does not edit the Definition of done section
Runs dod.mjs adr-check until it passes, shows the ADR to the user, and commits only the ADR and the index README
Tells the user to set dodFile to the ADR path in plan.json or findings.json, or that the ADR is found by its touches
Reports whether the pre-commit hook was installed, or the line to add when a hook manager owns the hooks
